widgets.name: Button

Merges A's ToolbarButton and IconButton action uses with B's Button (B's consolidation, with A's exact sizes, radii and tones kept where they are visible).

White fill with a border and bold centred label. Reset all settings, Reset cancel (A's mapping, from the code default), and the capture-bar well buttons Clear draft and Attach screenshot (md, 8px radius, bordered well look kept).
No fill at rest, grey text, wash on hover. Every toolbar, footer, bulk grid, section header, trash strip, title-bar icon, rich-text link button. The default.
Solid danger fill oklch 0.55 0.2 27 with light text. Destructive confirm only: Reset confirm. Text-level danger is the tone axis, not this variant.

Section header actions (Note, Shot, Link, File), trash strip, toast Undo, capture-bar wells Clear draft (16px glyph, catalogue exception) and Attach screenshot.

Section header action, Note, text and icon
Section attachment action, Shot, Link and File
Clear draft button, extra small well
Attach screenshot button, extra small well
widgets.platform: Same widget and look on both. Title bar exists on both. Desktop-only rows (no web equivalent): Shot, Attach screenshot, Clear draft. Settings: desktop opens a new Settings window; web navigates to a settings page or in-app dialog (assumption, not in source). Lightbox open externally: desktop leaves the app for the default external app; web opens a new tab or downloads (assumption); the label should change on web. Copy a file and File: desktop copies in; web uploads (assumption). Link: A says a URL or file on both; B says URL only on web (conflict, see open). Restore all and Empty apply to the signed-in user's own trash on web (assumption; multi-user not in source).
widgets.open: (1) Toast Dismiss, about 7px from Undo, is not catalogued. Add a row, or assign it to a ghost Button default. (2) Lightbox Open externally: look and hover were not measured; primary is a guess (B). (3) Reset cancel: look not captured; outline (A, from the code default) used, B used neutral. Confirm. (4) Attach screenshot attached state: A says accent fill, B says neutral; neutral used because attached is not selection. Confirm. (5) Footer Delete, bulk Delete and Trash Empty are grey in the reference; the library renders danger tone red (bulk Delete colour not recorded). Confirm. (6) No confirmation recorded for footer or bulk delete; Trash Empty asks 'Empty Trash?'. Product must decide. (7) Clear draft and Attach screenshot are removed from the Tab order (A tabbable false, B tabIndex -1). The shortcuts become the only keyboard route; state this and record the accessibility impact. (8) Shared action specs: Note header, empty-state Add note (DashedButton) and draft Note share setAddingNote; Link header, Add a link tile (TileButton) and rich-text Add link share addLink; File header and Copy a file tile share addFile. One action spec should back each group. (9) Small sizes below 24px: sm (21px) and the folded footer sort and filter (19px, 11px label, now Toggle sm 21px and 12px) are under the WCAG 2.2 24px target minimum; spacing or a larger hit area is needed. (10) Radius: B folded 5px and 8px to the size rule; kept the catalogue's exact 5px (icon md) and 8px (outline well). Clear draft label 11px vs Attach 12px is unresolved (merged to 12px). (11) Glyph sizes: catalogue 16px (sm icon, md, Clear draft) snaps to the standard 15px (sm) and 14px (md); Clear draft keeps its 16px exception. Confirm. (12) Label scale at lg: 12px/18px (catalogue ToolbarButton lg) vs 12.5px/18.75px (B for sheet, reset and filter buttons); 12px kept as measured. (13) Link platform conflict: A says a URL or file on both; B says URL only on web. Unresolved. (14) Catalogue row count is 95 against a source count of 96; one row may be missing between rows 37 and 52, so the footer and grid may be incomplete. (15) Footer Sort and filter is a Toggle, not a Button (see Toggle).

widgets.open: (1) Title-bar toggles change their label in the reference (Split view / Close split view; Hide preview panel / Show preview panel). Proposed: one constant label with aria-pressed. Confirm. (2) Preview glyph swaps in the reference (right_panel_close when shown, right_panel_open when hidden); the icon pair above keeps it. Confirm, or fix the glyph. (3) Split view and preview on multi-inspector, filter-panel and trash are inferred from labels, not verified in code. (4) Footer Sort and filter shows its non-default state as accent text with a Filtered label; accent is reserved for primary action and selection, so the library uses strong neutral text. Confirm. (5) Footer Sort and filter 19px and 11px label fold to sm 21px and 12px; the 19px height is below the 24px target (see Button). (6) Glyph weight: 300 in the title bar, 400 in the capture-bar formatting row; 300 used throughout (assumption). (7) Glyph sizes: sm 15px and md 14px snap from the reference 16px; lg 19px title bar. (8) Sort and filter is a dark or grey icon by panel state in the reference; pressed carries that.

(3) Shared handler: addFile (File header and Copy a file tile) and addLink (Link header and Add a link tile). One action spec. (4) Tile size 139 by 63px is fixed; no size axis (critique: single-value axis removed).

widgets.name: TextButton
widgets.purpose: Inline text-style button for values and small open-something actions: task title, notes hint, path and the capture-bar footer target. No fill at rest. Carries the truncate, mono, block and done behaviour that Button does not have (B's fold rejected per critique).
widgets.base: shadcn Button variant ghost (text only, no underline)

values.when: Primary text oklch 0.26 0.012 262. Open task title.
Muted text oklch 0.62 0.013 264 or 0.46 0.013 262. Path, capture-bar footer target, notes hint.
Muted with a line-through. Done task title (done-lamp colour is an open question).
12px/16px text, 16px tall. Capture-bar footer target and notes hint.
13.5px/20.25px (task title) to 14px/21px (path), 20 to 21px tall.
Colour step only: footer target content-2 to content-1; task title hover not defined.
wash-1 background on hover (path button).

props.name: children
props.description: Label text.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Default true. Ellipsis when the label is wider than the box.

props.name: mono
props.description: Monospace 11.5px/17.25px for paths.

props.name: block
props.description: Full-row hint style: left aligned, padded (px 3, py 2).

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown as a muted dash when the value is null (path).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name when the visible text is a value rather than an action (for example 'Open /Users/you/.taskscape in the file manager').

props.name: onClick
props.description: Handler.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Muted, no activation.

widgets.role: button (kind link is not used: each row opens or selects, none navigates in place)
widgets.keyboard: Enter and Space activate. Normal Tab order. No arrow-key behaviour.
widgets.platform: Task title: same on both. Path (opens the folder in the file manager) and capture target (opens the main Taskscape window) are desktop only: web has no local folders and no separate main window. Notes hint is capture-bar only (desktop).
widgets.open: (1) Done title: muted grey with line-through in the reference, but the decision says done has its own done-lamp colour. Confirm. (2) Task title hover style is undefined in the reference. (3) Capture footer position conflicts between recordings (y156 against y143); unresolved. (4) Path open target on the about screen is not confirmed. (5) Path size: mono prop gives 11.5px/17.25px, while the path row is 14px/21px at md. Unresolved within A. (6) Notes hint height: A gives 16px (sm); B's fold says 32px and weight 400. A's 16px kept; confirm. (7) Kept as role button, not link: each opens or selects.

notWidgets.reason: No visible control. ArrowRight and ArrowLeft step through attachments with stopPropagation in a window keydown listener (capture phase). A keymap of the lightbox screen, not a button. Same on web and desktop. Merged from A and B.

No visible control in the code read. Escape is the dialog primitive's job (Overlay captureEscape). Row 36's tooltip 'Close Esc' implies a visible Close control that has no row in the catalogue (critique). Confirm whether a Close button exists; if so add a row and map it to Button ghost. Same on both.
No visible control. A keydown handler on the capture-bar card hides the bar while the title or notes have focus. Desktop only, since the capture bar does not exist on web.

No visible control. Enter without Shift in the capture-bar title field saves the draft (App keydown handler). A key binding on the input; desktop only. The same Enter-to-save convention can be shared with web's by-hand task entry (proposal).

No visible control. Mod+Enter in the notes editor (RichTextEditor submitOnModEnter) saves the draft. Editor key binding; Mod is Command on macOS and Control on Windows and web. Desktop only in the reference (capture-bar notes).

No visible control. Tab in the capture-bar title field opens the notes editor (prevents default). It takes Tab from normal focus order, so it needs the visible Notes hint TextButton and an accessibility check (A and B both flag this). Desktop only.

No visible control. A keymap entry (Mod+Shift+Backspace) for the same action as the Clear draft Button, shown on its tooltip through the shortcut prop. Desktop only; the reference treats it as active whenever the bar is shown. If global, the main window handles it while focused (decision).

No visible control. A hotkey (Mod+Shift+Enter, screenshot_capture) shown only as a label on the Attach screenshot button. Desktop only; web has no screenshots or global hotkeys. Binding file not read, so its effect is unverified; probably global.

Duplicates Button (shape icon) and Toggle (shape icon). Its action uses move to Button shape icon (lg, glyph 19px for the title bar; sm 21px for the rich-text add link), and its pressed uses move to Toggle. Its xl, sm and md size names are renamed onto the one size scale (xl becomes lg; 24px merges with md). Its link mark active look becomes Button active, not aria-pressed. retainFocus is kept on Toggle and DashedButton, but not on the add link (catalogue says mousedown runs addLink with no preventDefault). Replaces re-homed.

Folded into Button (B's consolidation; A's text-and-icon ghost action distinction is not felt by the user). Its tone, size and appearance axes move to Button; its appearance well becomes Button outline. Its pressed use (footer Sort and filter) moves to Toggle, its opensMenu uses move to MenuButton, and its xs 19px size is dropped (single use; the control is now Toggle sm 21px, recorded as a fold in Button open). Replaces re-homed.

Split by job: the project switcher pill is a menu of actions with a New project row, so it moves to MenuButton; the filter field is a single choice, so it moves to Select. Both replaces re-homed; the pill and field measurement conflicts are recorded in MenuButton and Select.

Duplicates SegmentedControl: same replaces (sort direction, capture mode) and both are single-choice groups. Its multiple type is not used by any row. Role change (radiogroup vs radio items) recorded in SegmentedControl open.
Text-only look duplicates TextButton (task title and capture-bar target). TextButton carries the truncate, mono, block and done behaviour that Button lacks.

Single value, look only; the on and off look is the Toggle's only look. No axis.
Single value (md, now the 26px measured field). Fixed, not an axis.
Single value (md, 139 by 63px). Fixed, not an axis (critique).
Duplicates the Button variant (primary, neutral, danger). DialogButton passes variant through to Button; one owner for the look.
